88 Kix On
is a various artists compilation album released in Australia in June 1988 on the Polystar record Label (catalogue number 816 762 1). It spent two weeks at the top of the Australian albums chart in 1988. It was issued on a vinyl
LP
with 16 tracks and on
cassette
and
CD
with 18 tracks.
